assertions.name: c3_experimental_uncertainty_is_order_unity
assertions.source: δc_3/|c_3| = 0.610 (~61% experimental uncertainty from δQ/u³) — c_3 is a low-significance datum, confirming the data-block.

assertions.name: c4_unmeasured_uncertainty_exceeds_value
assertions.source: c_4 extracts to 0 (no residual datum) with nominal error bar δc_4 = 1.5e+02 — c_4 is experimentally unmeasured; recurrence-fitting to c_4+ is circular.

description: Quantifies why the q-difference / C-finite recurrence axis for the Q_β c_k ladder (PR #1824 §3.b) is DATA-BLOCKED. Propagates the CODATA Q_β experimental uncertainty through the ladder inversion c_k = (Q_codata/Q_{N(k-1)}−1)/u^k: δc_k ≈ (δQ/Q)/u^k explodes with k (u≈0.0085), so c_2 (proved-exact) is the only reliable coefficient, c_3 is a ~1–2σ datum, and c_4+ are experimentally unmeasured. A recurrence (order ≥2) needs ≳4 reliable coefficients ⇒ unidentifiable; the earlier c_{k+1}/c_k→1/u asymptotic is a circular-extraction artifact. No fits. Completes PR #1824's generating-function axis triage (closed-form refuted in #1866/#1880).

data.interpretation: Only c_2 is reliably measured (and it is a proved constant). c_3 carries ~60% experimental uncertainty; c_4+ have error bars far larger than their values. The q-difference recurrence axis is therefore undetermined by data, not refutable or confirmable numerically. Fitting to extracted c_4..c_k is circular. Resolvable only by sub-CAL-2 Q_β precision (declined) or structural Habiro derivation (the keystone).
